name: Expatriate Work Permit (EIC Directive No. 772/2021)

requirements.blocker_text: Job offer from a wholly foreign-owned investment enterprise, a joint venture, or a domestic-investor-status employer. No formal labour-market test is required (employers need not prove local-worker unavailability), but the employer must submit a knowledge-transfer/localization plan and quarterly performance reports, and generally cannot re-hire a new expatriate into a role a foreign national has held for the prior 3 years absent a documented failed transfer.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable up to a maximum of 3 years for non-management roles; top-management positions have no stated duration limit; companies with USD 40M+ capital or 1,500+ employees may exceed normal duration limits 'under compelling circumstances'

sources.title: Mehrteab Leul & Associates (law firm) -- summary of Ethiopian Investment Commission Directive No. 772/2021 governing work permits for expatriate employees: applies to wholly foreign-owned investments, joint ventures, and (per the Right to Work Directive framework) refugees with valid ID seeking wage employment; no formal labour-market test but mandatory knowledge-transfer obligations and duration caps
